Services

Optical services in Garden Grove

Frames, lenses, contacts and more — handled by opticians who fit every pair in person. Most glasses are ready in about 3 business days because we cut and fit lenses in our own in-store lab.

Progressive Lenses

One pair for distance, computer and reading — no visible line.

Blue Light & Transitions Lenses

Screen-friendly coatings and lenses that darken in the sun.

Prescription Sunglasses

Polarized and tinted lenses made to your prescription.

Contact Lenses

Daily, monthly, toric and multifocal lenses from your current prescription.

Kids' Glasses & Myopia Control

Myopia control lenses and MiSight® contact lenses for nearsighted kids.

Sports Goggles

Protective eyewear with your prescription for basketball, racquet sports and more.

Lens Replacement in Your Frame

Love your frame? Keep it — we'll put new lenses in it, even if you bought it elsewhere.

Need an eye exam first?

An independent optometrist practices right next door.

New Optix is an optical shop — we don't perform eye exams. If you need a new prescription, Dr. Amy [Last Name], OD is located in the same building, so you can have your eyes examined and then choose your glasses without driving across town. Prescriptions from any eye doctor are always welcome here.

The optometry practice next door is an independently owned and operated business. New Optix does not provide eye examinations. You are free to have your eyes examined, and your prescription filled, wherever you choose.

Bring your prescription — or your favorite frame — and we’ll take it from there.
